review_disposition: The requested current-run pixel review is complete with the recorded viewport findings and evidence limits. This is not a product-wide acceptance decision.

primary_finding.finding: After the named body scroll, Star table · round 1, Your turn and the full Orbit claimed 2 Stars. line remain readable together with the selected first Star and the complete Play 1, Challenge Orbit and Return to lobby controls.
primary_finding.limitation: Seat names have scrolled above the body viewport and right-side seat details remain horizontally clipped. The claim state does not display a separate generic play instruction. Control execution is outside this pixel finding.

findings.finding: After the named body scroll, Star table · round 1, Your turn and the full Orbit claimed 2 Stars. line remain readable together with the selected first Star and the complete Play 1, Challenge Orbit and Return to lobby controls.
findings.limitation: Seat names have scrolled above the body viewport and right-side seat details remain horizontally clipped. The claim state does not display a separate generic play instruction. Control execution is outside this pixel finding.

findings.finding: Shown hands have five readable ranks and a single first-card selection marker. Concealed entry/Hide checkpoints show card backs; the private rank labels and selected badge are absent after Hide.
findings.limitation: Only the captured endpoints are established. Continuous concealment, privacy-cover timing, accessibility-node removal and focus semantics are not established.

findings.finding: Both result stills show the true claim and two public Wilds; the native result includes complete Next round and Return to lobby controls. These are public gameplay result cards.
findings.limitation: The still alone does not establish the native Play input or same-session return. The separate current observations and executed source checks carry those behavioral claims.

findings.finding: The lobby control is partly clipped in the initial native states and later pre-scroll selection. Standard result content clips the lower fuse explanation and does not show the lower continuation controls. Native seat details remain horizontally clipped, with a scrollbar/swipe hint.
findings.limitation: Controls absent from the Standard captured viewport are not proved unreachable. Native art appears softer than UI text, without a diagnosis of the rendering cause or a performance claim.

separate_current_evidence.passive_scroll: The raw body-scroll JSON records one drag, selectedCount 1, handConcealed false, canChallenge true and complete lobby/Play/Challenge bounds, with authority intent count unchanged at 0. Source uses performTap: false.
separate_current_evidence.accepted_native_play: Sequence 952 has no lastViewerReceipt, revision 7 and intentEvents 0. Sequence 962 records accepted PLAY_CARDS for session/presentation 1, revision 7→8, serial 1 and intentEvents 1; by the image checkpoint the controller is at revision 10 and ROUND_ENDED.
separate_current_evidence.standard_return: Paired sequence 1008 records the same session 1, COMPOSE ordinal 0, native dormant/emptyTree true and lastCloseSucceeded true. These are diagnostic facts, separate from the Standard pixels.
separate_current_evidence.later_context: The later selected/scroll/Hide identities carry session 3, native presentation 4, intentEvents 0 and a retained old-session NEXT_ROUND receipt. Process 12118/bootstrapCount 1/retained identities are diagnostics.

limitations: Nine identities only: eight direct original views, one separately named complete-byte match. Twelve remaining case captures are explicitly unviewed in this assignment.
The first selected-hand still precedes Hide and a subsequent Reveal/selection before Play; it is not the immediate pre-Play image.
No dedicated native screenshots cover the second or third native entry. Standard/Leave views and prior-run frames cannot fill that gap.
Screenshot/paired JSON attachment times differ by 0–3 ms, but capture() attaches cached lastDocument. Neither simultaneous state sampling nor input latency is established.
Current passive scroll evidence has canChallenge true and complete bounds, but performTap is false and native intentEvents remain zero; no Challenge, Play or lobby action is proved by this helper.
Later retained NEXT_ROUND belongs to session 1 / COMPOSE, not a fresh action in session 3 / native presentation 4.
Pixels do not establish session identity, native close/dormancy, engine bootstrap reuse, continuous privacy, accessibility, performance, device/network behavior, signing or shipping readiness.
This review did not build, download, rerun native tests, generate videos, transform images, audit package bytes again, modify shared source, or perform Git operations.
